post.description: You know the EventId and the electoral division number (from `election_results`) and need results at voting-location level.

ed.description: Electoral division number 01..87 (two digits; `1` is accepted and padded). Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,2}$.

event_id.description: Elections Alberta numeric EventId as used on officialresults.elections.ab.ca (101 = Provincial General Election May 29, 2023; 130 = By-Election September 14, 2026). `list_events` returns them. Referendum (68RQ1) and senate (67S) ids use other page templates and are rejected. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

post.description: You have a party id from `list_parties` and want its filings and officers; pass `year` to get one financial year.

party_id.description: Party id (PID) from `list_parties`, e.g. 16 = United Conservative Party of Alberta. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,6}$.

year.description: Keep only the financial periods of this year (`2023` = 2023 PGE Campaign, 2023 Annual, 2023 Quarterly). Omit for the whole history (long-lived parties have 25+ periods). Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}$.
